entry: Read the supplied Jira ticket and reachable source specification in the assigned workstream; obtain current evidence rather than trusting chat text or a launch-time status claim.
exit: Submit PASS only if the ticket is Ready and the source is sufficient, with claims.modifiedFiles empty, observed ticket status, source locator and revision, and evidence references.
Otherwise submit an evidenced non-PASS result; a retry must inspect fresh evidence.
steps.mission: Decide whether the ticket is sufficiently specified and currently Ready for delivery. Do not groom, edit Jira, approve the packet or modify repository files.
steps.name: Check delivery readiness

entry: Read the Ready ticket, pinned source specification and preflight evidence.
exit: Return one forge.business-outputs.v1 artifact with applicability.detailed_spec, applicability.ux_spec, applicability.technical_spec and applicability.qa_spec. Each decision has applicable (Boolean) and a nonempty reason. Include evidence references; do not silently drop a discipline or start Build.
steps.mission: Decide whether detailed product, UX, technical and QA specifications are applicable, with reasons for every decision.
steps.name: Assess design applicability

entry: Read the pinned source and detailed-product applicability decision.
exit: Return the produced document path, locator, revision and content digest, or the explicit not-applicable reason.
steps.mission: Produce the detailed product specification when applicable; otherwise preserve the evidenced not-applicable decision.
steps.name: Prepare detailed product design

entry: Read the pinned source, product design evidence and UX applicability decision.
exit: Return the produced document path, locator, revision and content digest, or the explicit not-applicable reason.
steps.mission: Produce the UX specification when applicable; otherwise confirm the evidenced not-applicable decision without changing the source.
steps.name: Prepare UX design

entry: Read the pinned source, design evidence and technical applicability decision.
exit: Return the produced document path, locator, revision and content digest, or the explicit not-applicable reason.
steps.mission: Produce the technical specification when applicable; otherwise confirm the evidenced not-applicable decision.
steps.name: Prepare technical design

entry: Read every applicable design, its pinned revision and all not-applicable decisions.
exit: Return a forge.business-outputs.v1 artifact with nonempty delivery_plan.steps. Every ordered item needs a distinct id, title, stack (frontend or backend), safe relative file_paths, verification command and depends_on (null or the id of an earlier item), including for a trivial change. Also return the plan document path, locator, revision and content digest.
steps.mission: Produce a nonempty implementation plan with ordered, bounded code items, stack, dependencies and file scopes, including for a trivial change.
steps.name: Prepare implementation plan

entry: Read the pinned source, applicable specifications, implementation plan and QA applicability decision.
exit: Return the QA specification path, locator, revision and digest when applicable, or its not-applicable reason. Always return a forge.business-outputs.v1 artifact with nonempty verification_plan Markdown and the plan document path, locator, revision and digest.
steps.mission: Produce the QA specification when applicable and a nonempty verification plan on every route.
steps.name: Prepare QA design and verification plan

entry: Read the pinned source specification, every produced design and plan, and all applicability decisions.
exit: Commit the complete packet to the source Git repository. Return the canonical manifest bytes and SHA-256, pinned repository and commit, and verified paths and document digests; stop if Git or any committed object is unavailable or mismatched.
steps.mission: Assemble one packet-manifest.v1 with every applicable document and produced plan. Validate paths, revisions, hashes and applicability against actual document bytes.
steps.name: Assemble complete design packet

entry: Present the complete packet at its pinned source Git commit and canonical manifest SHA-256, including every applicability decision. Stop if the source repository or committed objects are unavailable or mismatched.
exit: Record the authenticated human decision against the same pinned repository, commit and canonical manifest SHA-256; a changed packet requires a new decision.
steps.mission: Approve or reject this exact packet revision before any Build step.
steps.name: Approve complete design packet

entry: Read the approved packet at its pinned Git commit and the ordered delivery_plan.steps. Confirm that the human packet gate covers the same manifest digest; stop on a mismatch or unavailable Git source.
exit: Return one forge.business-outputs.v1 artifact with build_report: manifest_sha256, work_commit and one ordered item receipt for every planned step. Each receipt needs step_id, stack, PASS status, summary and changed_files within that item's scope. Do not approve the implementation or declare delivery complete.
steps.mission: Coordinate Backend and Frontend specialists through the approved plan in order inside this one Build step; resume delegated work without repeating completed items and report each item truthfully.
steps.name: Build planned implementation
